C0.quote: we study the complexity of deciding whether voters’ preferences can be explained
C0.note: Computational social choice paper on recognizing and partitioning structured preference profiles.

C1.quote: For k ≥ 3, the problem is known to be hard
C1.note: Complexity and algorithm results for voter-partition problems.

C2.2.note: Inputs are strict linear orders over candidates.

C2.4.quote: A preference profile P over a candidate set C
C2.4.note: Input profile is described as preferences and used directly; no reporting or submission statement.
